entries.build_command: make O=<isolated-build> INSTALL_HDR_PATH=<isolated-headers> headers_install; reproducer.sh compiles ctl_maxname_probe.c against each installed header tree
entries.reachability_signal: headers_install preserves the changed UAPI macro and GCC expands it into distinct executable probe constants; the runner prints reachability=headers_install output expanded include/uapi/linux/sysctl.h:30
entries.expected_signal: before CTL_MAXNAME/array_count=10, after=8; nlen 9 and 10 change from accepted to rejected; legacy CTL_MAXNAME>=9 consumer changes from compile success to static-assert failure
entries.input_strategy: Exercise negative, empty/zero, new exact boundary 8, old-valid/new-invalid 9 and 10, old-invalid 11, plus an unchanged legacy compile-time requirement.
entries.limitations: CTL_MAXNAME has no kernel execution-code references in this baseline, so this is a compile-time UAPI consumer entry. The macro declaration has no runtime gcov counter.
